messages.subject: utah shapefile and geom_text
parts:
HI:
Downloaded the example on Hadley's github:
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/plotting-polygon-shapefiles
but I am having problems adding labels to each of the regions.
I would like to add the "ECO" Labels to each region but geom_text()
returns multiple values even with the use of 'aes'. See below:

require("rgdal") # requires sp, will use proj.4 if installed
require("maptools")
require("ggplot2")
gpclibPermit() # required for fortify method

utah = readOGR(dsn=".", layer="eco_l3_ut")
names(utah)
utah@data$id = rownames(utah@data)
utah.points = fortify.SpatialPolygonsDataFrame(utah, region="id")
utah.df = join(utah.points, utah@data, by="id")
head(utah.df)
str(utah.df)

ggplot(utah.df) +
aes(long,lat,group=group,fill=LEVEL3_NAM) +
geom_polygon() +
geom_path(color="white") +
coord_equal() +
scale_fill_brewer("Utah Ecoregion") +
geom_text(aes(label=ECO)) # geom_text not working here
